criteria.support_condition: Representative evidence establishes substitutable LLM offerings, sustained price competition, and persistently low realized revenue attributable to that competition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence establishes durable differentiation and sustained substantial realized revenue despite price competition.
